note: Longitudinal geotechnical sections marked by the user on the general plan (2026-10-23). Each cut is a vertical plane parallel to the stationing (model Y) at a constant offset from the bridge PGL; positive offsets are north (model +X, up on the plan). Sections run from the pier centerline (match line) to clearance_ft beyond the outermost project element on the exterior side. Offsets of A-1/B-1 were scaled from the marked plan (2.72 px/ft) and rounded; A-2/B-2 were drawn about 2 ft off the PGL and are taken on the PGL.
